name: Funahashi Asuna
source:
A student of the class. She is a cheerful girl, sometimes she gets flustered by taking other people's joke too seriously. Her parents have a small coffee shop outside of ward 13. 

Being an obedient child, she never speaks her mind in front of them, not even her wish of [spoiler]"moving out together with everyone". It's because of her parents' duty to take care of a tree in the town's shrine, which is said to protect this town.[/spoiler]

She is a childhood friend of [url=/c91284]Takeshi[/url], and is on good terms with [url=/c91252]Mirai[/url] as well. The three of them used to play catch together before Alice comes to town. Despite her cheerful appearance, she can be very serious and mature occasionally.
